## Activity

During March 2026, Market Eye Clinic completed 430 captures as part of its routine activity. The reported volume reflects the number of images submitted for grading during the month. Clinic staff should continue to record operational issues through the established reporting process so that any recurring problems can be reviewed and addressed.

## Image quality

Of the 430 captures completed, 89 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 20.7 per cent. The clinic lead has asked that recurring camera issues be logged with the service desk. Consistent recording of these issues will support follow-up and help identify whether equipment or capture conditions are contributing to the image-quality results.

## Grading

Grading identified 91 referable results during the reporting period. The median lag between image capture and completion of grading was 2. This provides the central measure of turnaround for the month. The activity, image-quality and grading figures should be retained for routine operational monitoring and considered alongside future monthly reports to identify any changes in workload, image quality or grading performance.
